sun.definition: Form of sunn (alternative uncountable): An East Indian leguminous plant of species Crotalaria juncea, yielding a fiber.

table.definition: Furniture with a top surface to accommodate a variety of uses.

tailor.definition: To make, repair, or alter clothes.

take.definition: To get into one's hands, possession, or control, with or without force.

takes.definition: Form of take (indicative present singular third-person): To get into one's hands, possession, or control, with or without force.

taking.definition: Form of take (gerund participle present): To get into one's hands, possession, or control, with or without force.

talk.definition: To communicate, usually by means of speech.

talking.definition: Form of talk (gerund participle present): To communicate, usually by means of speech.

taste.definition: One of the sensations produced by the tongue in response to certain chemicals; the quality of giving this sensation.

tea.definition: The tea plant (Camellia sinensis); (countable) a variety of this plant.

teapot.definition: A vessel for brewing and serving tea, typically with a handle and spout.

teeth.definition: Form of tooth (plural): A hard, calcareous structure present in the mouth of many vertebrate animals, generally used for biting and chewing food.

tell.definition: Mental senses related to determining, reckoning, or perceiving.

telling.definition: Form of tell (gerund participle present): Mental senses related to determining, reckoning, or perceiving.

ten.definition: A set or group with ten elements.

thank.definition: To express appreciation or gratitude toward (someone or something).

that.definition: To a given extent or degree.

that’s.definition: To a given extent or degree.

the.definition: With a comparative or with more and a verb phrase, establishes a correlation with one or more other such comparatives.

their.definition: Form of there (misspelling): In or at a place or location (stated, implied or otherwise indicated) that is perceived to be away from, or at a relative distance from, the speaker (compare here).

there.definition: In or at a place or location (stated, implied or otherwise indicated) that is perceived to be away from, or at a relative distance from, the speaker (compare here).

there’s.definition: In or at a place or location (stated, implied or otherwise indicated) that is perceived to be away from, or at a relative distance from, the speaker (compare here).

they.definition: To refer to (someone, sometimes especially someone who does not use gender-neutral pronouns) using they/them pronouns.

thick.definition: Relatively great in extent from one surface to the opposite in its smallest solid dimension.

thing.definition: That which is considered to exist as a separate entity, object, quality or concept.

things.definition: Form of thing (plural): That which is considered to exist as a separate entity, object, quality or concept.

think.definition: To ponder, to go over in one's mind.

thinking.definition: Form of think (gerund participle present): To ponder, to go over in one's mind.

third.definition: The person or thing in the third position.

this.definition: To the degree or extent indicated.

thread.definition: To pass a thread through the eye of a needle.

throwing.definition: Form of throw (gerund participle present): To hurl; to release (an object) with some force from one’s hands, an apparatus, etc. so that it moves rapidly through the air.

tidied.definition: Form of tidy (participle past): To make tidy; to neaten.

time.definition: The inevitable progression into the future with the passing of present and past events.

to.definition: Toward a closed, touching, or engaging position.

tobacco.definition: Any plant of the genus Nicotiana.

towards.definition: In the direction of something (indicated by context).

tramp.definition: Form of trampoline (abbreviation clipping): A gymnastic and recreational device consisting of a piece of taut, strong fabric or rubber stretched over a (usually steel) frame using many coiled springs as anchors.

trembling.definition: Form of tremble (gerund participle present): To shake, quiver, or vibrate.

truth.definition: True facts, genuine depiction or statements of reality.

tumbling.definition: Form of tumble (gerund participle present): To fall end over end; to roll over and over.

turf.definition: A layer of earth covered with grass; sod.

turning.definition: Form of turn (gerund participle present): To make a non-linear physical movement.

turns.definition: Form of turn (indicative present singular third-person): To make a non-linear physical movement.

under.definition: In or to a lower or subordinate position, or a position beneath or below something, physically or figuratively.

us.definition: The relationship between the speaker and some other unspecified person.

used.definition: Form of use (participle past): To utilize or employ.

very.definition: To a great extent or degree.

voice.definition: Sound uttered by the mouth, especially by human beings in speech or song; sound thus uttered considered as possessing some special quality or character.

wait.definition: To delay movement or action until some event or time; to remain neglected or in readiness.

wake.definition: (often followed by up) To stop sleeping.

walk.definition: To move on the feet by alternately setting each foot (or pair or group of feet, in the case of animals with four or more feet) forward, with at least one foot on the ground at all times. Compare run.

walking.definition: Form of walk (gerund participle present): To move on the feet by alternately setting each foot (or pair or group of feet, in the case of animals with four or more feet) forward, with at least one foot on the ground at al.

wall.definition: A rampart of earth, stones etc. built up for defensive purposes.

was.definition: Form of be (first-person indicative past singular): As an auxiliary verb.

wasn’t.definition: Form of was (abbreviation auxiliary contraction): Form of be (first-person indicative past singular): As an auxiliary verb.

way.definition: To do with a place or places.

ways.definition: Form of way (plural): To do with a place or places.

webs.definition: Form of web (plural): The silken structure which a spider builds using silk secreted from the spinnerets at the caudal tip of its abdomen; a spiderweb.

went.definition: Form of go (past): To move, either physically or in an abstract sense.

were.definition: Form of be (indicative past second-person singular): As an auxiliary verb.

wet.definition: Made up of liquid or moisture, usually (but not always) water.

what.definition: In what way; to what extent.

when.definition: At what time? At which time? Upon which occasion or circumstance? Used to introduce direct or indirect questions about time.

while.definition: An uncertain duration of time, a period of time.

whisky.definition: Form of whiskey (Australia Canada New-Zealand Scotland alternative countable uncountable): A liquor distilled from the fermented mash of grain (as rye, corn, or barley).

whistle.definition: To make a shrill, high-pitched sound by forcing air through the mouth. To produce a whistling sound, restrictions to the flow of air are created using the teeth, tongue and lips.

wicklow.definition: Form of whitlow (misspelling): Inflammation and/or infection in the cuticle and/or the nailbed of a fingernail or toenail.

wife.definition: A married woman, especially in relation to her spouse.

will.definition: Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

wind.definition: Real or perceived movement of atmospheric air usually caused by convection or differences in air pressure.

window.definition: An opening, usually covered by one or more panes of clear glass, to allow light and air from outside to enter a building or vehicle.

winter.definition: Traditionally the fourth of the four seasons, typically regarded as spanning either the period between the winter solstice to the spring equinox, or the months of December, January, and February in temperate and polar re.

with.definition: Form of withe (alternative): A flexible, slender shoot or twig, especially when used as a band or for binding; a withy.

wonder.definition: A sense of awe, astonishment and curiosity, inspired by unexpected events, novel experiences and inexplicable circumstances, sometimes accompanied by surprise, shock or reverence.

won’t.definition: Will not (negative auxiliary); used to indicate a future non-occurring action.

word.definition: The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)

world.definition: The subjective human experience, regarded collectively; human collective existence; existence in general; the reality we live in.

would.definition: Past tense of will; usually followed by a bare infinitive.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: Offspring, especially the immature offspring of animals.
